requests.message: Hi Jordan — I'm a CS junior who also transferred from Sac City and I'm in ACM too. I saw you landed your first internship without prior experience, and I'd love to hear how you approached it.
Hi Sam — quick question: as a hiring manager, what makes a student project stand out to you on a resume?
Hi Maria — I'm a Business senior moving toward product, and I'd love your eyes on how I present my SQL and data projects.
Hi Aisha — I'm also in Women in Business and targeting PM roles. Would you be up for a mock PM interview? Your story of getting in without an internship really resonated with me.
Hi Grace — I'm a nursing sophomore and commuter from Stockton too. I'd love to hear how you got into ER nursing.
Hi Grace — thank you again for the chat! UC Davis Health just posted a student nurse extern role. Would you be open to referring me?

kudos.note: Jordan walked me through exactly how he found his first internship. I left with a plan for the next 3 months!
Super generous with his time and honest about what worked and what didn't.
Maria showed me there's more than one way into tech. So encouraging.
As a fellow Stockton commuter, it meant a lot to hear her story.
Sam's tips on what hiring managers look for were gold.
I had no idea how many product jobs the state has. Eye-opening!
Helped me think through switching majors without panicking.
Best mock interview I've had — I finally have a story for 'tell me about yourself.'
Kind, direct feedback on my portfolio. I redesigned two case studies after.
Grace is the reason I'm confident about clinicals. She even offered to refer me!
Made financial modeling way less intimidating.
Loved hearing how her senior project turned into a job offer.
